source_write_review.reason: WP23 introduces or edits actual product tests, worker implementation, CI and experiment scripts; exact-path Human Check/Work Order remains separate from node semantics.

domains.reason: Existing Precheck execution and SAE encoding are real source-backed behavior. Planned independent Dataset/Model probes and compatibility workers may create new source interfaces, but their AST and unique responsibilities do not exist yet; defer any Code node change until observed implementation.

WP23 validates whether existing scientific operations can be run reproducibly; it does not introduce a new scientific hypothesis, evaluation definition, explanation evidence, or research result. Existing Knowledge descriptions and relationships retain their meaning.

The plan will consume actual resource probes and permission controls, but does not alter the meaning of current-machine observations, hardware categories, or authorization semantics. Future machine snapshots remain per-run evidence, never durable tree edits.

The generic task precheck and Dataset/Model compatibility responsibilities are already represented by stable Core nodes. QA500 matrix sizes, feature site selections and test phases are a Workplan instance and do not change any Core node's abstract function or properties. The prior unapproved g.component_precheck proposal is not established as a distinct durable capability.

WP23 uses the current plan, review and contract controls without changing their durable purposes. A separate user-directed governance PR updates authoring policy, and is assessed independently from this study; attaching its instructions to a Core node would conflate process governance with study scope.

Dataset, Model, SAE, Task, source revisions and audit receipts use existing vocabulary. No new enduring technical definition is required for QA500, and repeating its task parameters in Context would introduce a redundant and unstable definition.

preimplementation_note: No Atlas node ADD/CHANGE/REMOVE is approved or proposed at planning stage. Reassess Code after observed AST source changes; if a genuinely independent durable capability appears, create separate HC with exact field and path diffs.
